block.guhs.gedenksteen.lore: An old stone with a story. Click to read.
block.guhs.geestenaarde.lore: Soil from the Spirit World. Smells of moonlight.
block.guhs.geestengras.lore: Lilac grass. Everything's the other way round here, nyeg.
block.guhs.geestenhout.lore: White wood with a blue grain. Only grows where nobody's looking.
block.guhs.geestenmasker.lore: A face from the wall of Koh's Cave. It looks at you, even when you look away.
block.guhs.geestenplanken.lore: Planks of spirit wood. They creak in another language.
block.guhs.geestlantaarn.lore: A lantern with a cool, blue light.
block.guhs.geestpaddenstoel_hoed.lore: Glows teal with pink spots. Don't eat it.
block.guhs.geestpaddenstoel_steel.lore: The stem of a giant mushroom. Soft and a little spongy.
block.guhs.gloeibladeren_cyaan.lore: Leaves that make their own light. Handy if you're scared of the dark.
block.guhs.gloeibladeren_roze.lore: A soft pink glow. The spirits find it cozy.
block.guhs.lotusblad.lore: A pale lotus leaf drifting in the mist. Holds a chonky guh.
block.guhs.lotuspuzzeltegel.lore: A piece of the White Lotus. Click to turn it.
block.guhs.maansteen.lore: Pale stone with a sheen of moon and ocean.
block.guhs.maansteen_plaat.lore: Half a moonstone tile. The other half is still on its way.
block.guhs.maansteen_tegels.lore: Old tiles of the spirit paths. Not swept in a thousand years.
block.guhs.maansteen_trap.lore: Stairs of moonstone. They go up, and also down.
block.guhs.meditatiesteen.lore: Sit still for a moment and click: your soul sniffs its way back to your body.
block.guhs.nevelwater.lore: Water that falls up. Don't think about it, nyeg.
block.guhs.schaduwbladeren.lore: Dark leaves from the edges of the wood. They whisper the loudest.
block.guhs.schaduwhout.lore: Black wood with a white grain: spirit wood on a bad day.
block.guhs.schaduwplanken.lore: Planks of shadow wood. They look a bit stern.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.aangekomen: Your eyes glow. You float... and land softly in the Spirit World.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.beschermd: Nothing changes in the Spirit World. Not even if you push really hard.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.geen_lore: This stone is so old that even its letters have fallen asleep.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.geen_terug: Your body wasn't anywhere any more: you wake up at your bed.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.leegte: The mist gently lifts you back to the Meditation Circle. Don't look down, nyeg.
The Guhvatar before you. Chonked out in a cheese ball for a hundred years and missed almost everything. Passed the torch to you. Laughs a lot, eats no meat, but lots and lots of nibbles.
Fang, Roku Guh's spirit dragon. He only flies with whoever Roku Guh trusts. And with whoever smells nice. Wash your ears, just to be safe.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.geest: A world next to ours, where almost nobody can go. Except the Guhvatar. And whoever stands very close to the Guhvatar. The grass is lilac, the wood is white and the water falls up. Why? The spirits say: why not?
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.geflu: The trees whisper. Mostly gossip about the Tea Spirit. Shadow spirits live in the dark edges: they nudge you aside a little and do nothing else. They're just shy.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.hei_b: The guardian spirit of a forest in the real world. When his forest burned down, he grew big and angry. An acorn from home makes him small and sweet again. Like everybody, really.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.hemel: Tui and La, the moon and the ocean: push and pull. As long as they swim their circles, the tide is right and the moon shines. Don't feed them: they're on a diet.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.koh.t: Show no emotion. Don't laugh, don't flinch, don't sneeze. Koh collects faces the way you collect nibbles. He never makes jokes. If he does make a joke anyway: don't laugh.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.kuruk: As a young Guhvatar he fought a hundred angry spirits. Then Koh stole the face of his beloved, Ummi Guh. Since then he trusts no centipede at all. Not even the little ones.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.kyosh: Tall, strict, and with fans you'd rather not get against your ears. Turned a peninsula into an island, just because she could. Her followers still wear her makeup.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.lanta: Every lantern spirit belongs on this tree. But lantern spirits are curious and wander off: eight hooks are empty. They'll surely come back, if somebody shows them the way.
Nothing here yet. This stone is waiting for the Guhvatar of today. That's you, nyeg. No scratching: it's just been polished.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.medit: Here your body sleeps, but your soul keeps sniffing around, nyeg.
Wise, calm, and an impressive beard. His best friend later became a Fire Lord with very bad ideas. Roku Guh says: choose your friends well. And your Fire Lords too.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.szeto: As Guhvatar he mostly worked on paperwork. Filled everything out in triplicate, here in the Spirit World too. His pile is still around somewhere. Don't touch it: it's sorted.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.theep: The Tea Spirit once came here for a cup and never left. He says: I know somebody else who wants to live here one day... round, beard, says wise things about tea.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.top.t: Here you speak with the Guhvatars of old. They mostly talk over each other, and Roku Guh always starts with: when I was young...
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.wan.t: The very first Guhvatar. Or was it a cheese nibble with big plans? The sources disagree. The sources are also a bit cheesy.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.witte: An old society of wise guhs who play Pai Sho, drink tea and quietly protect the world. Mostly drink tea. Lay the tiles as a lotus and the gate knows you're a friend.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.lore.yangc: Always said: the Guhvatar is there for the world, not for herself. Then she secretly ate the last nibble anyway. Nobody's perfect.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.niet_hier: Meditating only works in the Spirit World. Here it's just a stone.
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.opgelost: The lotus is whole! Somewhere an old gate sighs... (patience, nyeg)
gui.guhs.einde2_geestenwereld.terug: Your soul sniffs its way back to your body. Welcome back, nyeg.
